locator.section: RG115d complete ending and Amen wording; same-edition accented common stem and terminal typography

entries.claim: RG115d supplies the Son-directed Qui vivis ending w034–w049 and Amen w050. Its literal rubric formula is unaccented. Same-edition p.123 controls matching accented formula words, and p.226 controls the accented four-word terminal and separately marked Amen period. These controls do not make the proper page a full-ending witness or establish response actors, singing, or larger-group conclusion distribution.

locator.section: RG115d; this setting’s full ending and Amen

entries.claim: This setting’s own RG115d supplies its complete ad-filium ending and Amen, w034–w050. Its literal accents, punctuation and Amen list semicolon are retained. Formula wording alone does not establish response actors, singing or a rule for grouped orations.
